#############################Fig.S6_Mantel test_all##########################

library(vegan)
library(ggplot2)
library(linkET)
library(dplyr)
rm(list=ls())

# 读取otu表格
setwd("E:/Saline-alkali soil/Saline-alkali/amplicon/result-U/AMF/otu")
otu_amf <- read.csv("otu_amfFlattening.csv",check.names = F,row.names = 1,header = T)

setwd("E:/Saline-alkali soil/Saline-alkali/amplicon/result-U/Bacteria/otu")
otu_bacteria <- read.csv("otu_bacteriaFlattening.csv",check.names = F,row.names = 1,header = T)

setwd("E:/Saline-alkali soil/Saline-alkali/amplicon/result-U/Fungi/otu")
otu_fungi <- read.csv("otu_fungiFlattening.csv",check.names = F,row.names = 1,header = T)

setwd("E:/Saline-alkali soil/Saline-alkali/amplicon/result-U/Protist/otu")
otu_protist <- read.csv("otu_protistFlattening.csv",check.names = F,row.names = 1,header = T)

group0 <- read.csv("sample_metadata.csv")
group0$cnratio <- group0$tc/group0$tn
group0$npration <- group0$tn/group0$tp
group0$cpration <- group0$tc/group0$tp

# 检查列名是否相同
if(all(colnames(otu_amf) == colnames(otu_bacteria) & 
       colnames(otu_bacteria) == colnames(otu_fungi) & 
       colnames(otu_fungi) == colnames(otu_protist))) {
  print("列名相同")
} else {
  print("列名不同")
}

otu_all <- rbind(otu_amf,otu_bacteria,otu_fungi,otu_protist)
otu_all <- as.data.frame(t(otu_all))


# 创建spec.select参数的值，分组
spec_select <- list(AMF = 1:670,
                    Bacteria = 671:2593,
                    Fungi = 2594:5104,
                    Protist = 5105:7386)

# 计算alpha多样性——alpha多样性计算函数
alpha <- function(x, tree = NULL, base = exp(1)) {
  est <- estimateR(x)
  Richness <- est[1, ]
  Chao1 <- est[2, ]
  ACE <- est[4, ]
  Shannon <- diversity(x, index = 'shannon', base = base)
  Simpson <- diversity(x, index = 'simpson')    #Gini-Simpson 指数
  Pielou <- Shannon / log(ACE, base)
  goods_coverage <- 1 - rowSums(x == 1) / rowSums(x)
  
  result <- data.frame(Richness, Shannon, Simpson, Pielou, Chao1, ACE, goods_coverage)
  if (!is.null(tree)) {
    PD_whole_tree <- pd(x, tree, include.root = FALSE)[1]
    names(PD_whole_tree) <- 'PD_whole_tree'
    result <- cbind(result, PD_whole_tree)
  }
  result
}

# 计算不同类群的alpha多样性
alpha_amf <-      alpha(otu_all[,spec_select$AMF], base = 2)
colnames(alpha_amf) <- paste0("AM fungi_",colnames(alpha_amf), " diveristy")

alpha_bacteria <- alpha(otu_all[,spec_select$Bacteria], base = 2)
colnames(alpha_bacteria) <- paste0("Prokaryotes_",colnames(alpha_bacteria), " diveristy")

alpha_fungi <-    alpha(otu_all[,spec_select$Fungi], base = 2)
colnames(alpha_fungi) <- paste0("Fungi_",colnames(alpha_fungi), " diveristy")

alpha_protist <-  alpha(otu_all[,spec_select$Protist], base = 2)
colnames(alpha_protist) <- paste0("Protists_",colnames(alpha_protist), " diveristy")

# 合并不同类群的alpha多样性
# 检查列名是否相同
if(all(rownames(alpha_amf)      == rownames(alpha_bacteria) & 
       rownames(alpha_bacteria) == rownames(alpha_fungi) & 
       rownames(alpha_fungi)    == rownames(alpha_protist))) {
  print("行名相同")
} else {
  print("行名不同")
}

alpha_all <- cbind(alpha_amf[,1:2], alpha_bacteria[,1:2], alpha_fungi[,1:2], alpha_protist[,1:2])
alpha_all$sample.id <- rownames(alpha_all)
alpha_all <- alpha_all[,c(2,4,6,8,9)]

# 将多样性与环境因子合并
env <- group0[,c(1,9:17)]
env2 <- merge(env,alpha_all,by="sample.id")
rownames(env2) <- env2[,1]

env2 <- env2[,2:14]
colnames(env2)[1:9] <- c("pH","Salt content","Available phosphorus","Total nitrogen","Total carbon","Total phosphorus","Total carbon:Total nitrogen","Total nitrogen:Total phosphorus","Total carbon:Total phosphorus")


# 1. All
# 设定种子确保结果的可重复性
set.seed(42)

# 执行Mantel test
df_mantel <- mantel_test(otu_all, env2,
                         spec_dist = 'bray',  # 计算距离矩阵
                         env_dist = 'euclidean', # 计算距离矩阵
                         spec_select = spec_select)


# 为了使用geom_couple，为df_mantel增加连线的属性
df_mantel <- df_mantel %>%
  mutate(df_r = cut(r, breaks = c(-Inf, 0.1, 0.2, 0.4, Inf),
                    labels = c("< 0.1", "0.1 - 0.2", "0.2 - 0.4", ">= 0.4")),#定义Mantel的R值范围标签
         df_p = cut(p, breaks = c(-Inf, 0.01, 0.05, Inf),
                    labels = c("< 0.01", "0.01 - 0.05", ">= 0.05")))#定义Mantel的P值范围标签
head(df_mantel)

df_mantel$spec[df_mantel$spec=="AMF"] = "AM fungal\ncommunity\ncomposition"
df_mantel$spec[df_mantel$spec=="Bacteria"] = "Prokaryotic\ncommunity\ncomposition"
df_mantel$spec[df_mantel$spec=="Fungi"] = "Fungal\ncommunity\ncomposition"
df_mantel$spec[df_mantel$spec=="Protist"] = "Protistic\ncommunity\ncomposition"

# 画图 


p_all <- qcorrplot(correlate(env2,method = "spearman",adjust = TRUE, adjust_method = "fdr"), type = "upper", diag = FALSE) +
  geom_square() +
  geom_mark(sep = '\n',sig_thres = 0.05, size = 3, color = "white") +
  geom_couple(data = df_mantel, aes(color = df_p, size = df_r), 
              nudge_x = 0.5, curvature = nice_curvature(0.1,by = "to"),
              label.fontface = 2, label.size = 5) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colours = RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(11, "RdBu")) +
  scale_size_manual(values = c(0.5, 1, 1.5, 2)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = color_pal(3)) +
  annotate("text",x=-2,y=1,label="we", color="white") +  # display left text completely, add a white annotate
  guides(size = guide_legend(title = expression(paste(bold("Mantel's "),bolditalic("r"))),
                             override.aes = list(colour = "grey35"), 
                             order = 2),
         colour = guide_legend(title =  expression(paste(bold("Mantel's "),bolditalic("p"))),
                               override.aes = list(size = 3), 
                               order = 1),
         fill = guide_colorbar(title = expression(paste(bold("Spearman's "),bolditalic("ρ"))), order = 3)) +
          theme(plot.title = element_text(size=20,face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
                axis.text = element_text(size = 12,face = "bold"),
                legend.title = element_text(size = 16,face = "bold"),
                legend.text = element_text(size = 12,face = "bold"))
p_all
